summary: Runtime -i value initializes a host loop whose each pass launches spmvKernel for this rank's contiguous balanced row interval and synchronizes before the backedge. The kernel bounds each thread by numRowsLocal, follows rowDelimiters[startRow+i] through rowDelimiters[startRow+i+1], accumulates val[j]*vec[cols[j]], and stores the row sum. Rank intervals cover all rows; the shared CSR and vector are broadcast. The timed compiled host loop compares its incremented counter to the runtime iteration value and contains the launch plus device synchronization on every pass. Final SASS has a row bound and CSR loop with multiply-accumulate and result store. No work-count omission identified.

source_evidence.claim: CLI/default dimensions, sparsity and iterations define nItems; complete arrays are distributed via broadcasts; quotient/remainder partition assigns contiguous rows; each timed iteration launches the kernel and synchronizes; output is gathered.
Each launched thread computes one local row, iterating over its entire CSR interval and writing the accumulated result.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock starts before the runtime-controlled loop; each pass configures and launches spmvKernel, synchronizes, increments the loop counter, and branches back while counter differs from runtime iteration value; barrier and ending clock follow loop.
